description: The agent must: (1) Read the SKILL.md to discover the `python3 scripts/run.py --input <file> --output <file>` invocation pattern and the 6-section output structure. (2) Consolidate the three raw input files (data/raw/biz_unit_A/metrics_draft_v3.txt, data/raw/biz_unit_B/indicator_list_final.md, data/raw/legacy_finance/finance_kpi_partial.csv) into a single input brief, then invoke run.py via the mandated CLI or produce equivalent structured text output. (3) The output metric_catalog.md must contain all 6 sections: 指标目录, 口径定义, 计算方式, 不适用场景, 常见误用, 维护建议. (4) CRITICAL PROPRIETARY TRAP: For GMV, CVR, and 退款率 (which each have 2-3 conflicting definitions across departments), the skill mandates side-by-side display ('并排列出，避免强行合并') — the agent must NOT merge them into a single unified formula. (5) For NPS and LTV (which have no formulas in any source file), the skill mandates listing them as '待确认项' rather than fabricating definitions. (6) The output must carry a draft/草案 marker as the skill requires 'first give a reviewable draft'. An agent relying purely on general knowledge would likely produce a clean merged summary — failing the conflict side-by-side and fabrication checks.
